info.name: Autodesk ACC Account Admin Account Users Authorization API

params.name: response_type
params.description: Must be set to `code` for authorization code flow.

params.name: client_id
params.description: The Client ID of your APS application.

params.name: redirect_uri
params.description: The URI that Autodesk redirects the user to after granting consent. Must match a redirect URI registered with the application.

params.name: scope
params.description: Space-separated list of scopes requested. Common scopes include data:read, data:write, data:create, account:read, account:write.

params.name: state
params.description: An opaque value that the application uses to maintain state between the request and callback. Used to prevent CSRF attacks.

params.name: nonce
params.description: A random string used to associate a client session with an ID token.

params.name: prompt
params.description: Controls the authentication experience presented to the user.

items.docs: Redirects the user to the Autodesk login page where they grant your application access to their data. This is the first step of the three-legged OAuth flow. After the user grants consent, Autodesk redirects them back to the redirect URI with an authorization code.

params.name: post_logout_redirect_uri
params.description: URI to redirect the user to after logout.

items.docs: Ends the user's Autodesk session and optionally redirects the user to a specified URI.
